newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Essar offers Internet on mobile phones.
newsitem.headline: India's Essar offers Internet on mobile phones.

text.p: India's Sterling Cellular Ltd said on Thursday that it had launched e-mail, fax and Internet facilities through its mobile telephone network operating in Delhi under the Essar Cellphone brand name.

Subscribers to Essar's services can use the facilities through their computers at a charge of 800 rupees per month with the help of appropriate handsets and a data card compatible with mobile phones, company officials told a news conference.
India's Essar group holds 51 percent and Swiss Telecom 30 percent in Sterling Cellular.
